# litellm Provider

Manages the LiteLLM dynamic secrets engine (vault-plugin-secrets-litellm) on HashiCorp Vault or OpenBao: the engine mount, its connection to the LiteLLM proxy, and the roles that scope generated virtual keys.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    litellm = {
      source = "IUCLabs/vault-secrets-litellm"
    }
  }
}

# address and token fall back to VAULT_ADDR and VAULT_TOKEN
provider "litellm" {
  address = "https://vault.example.com:8200"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `address` (String) Address of the Vault/OpenBao server. Falls back to the VAULT_ADDR environment variable.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Token used to authenticate to Vault/OpenBao. Falls back to the VAULT_TOKEN environment variable.
